name: Tampines North Edge
summary: North edge of Tampines toward Pasir Ris / Loyang — denser new-town fringe living with DTL/EWL hops and community-sport catchment.
body: Tampines North Edge is the shortlist when denser Tampines convenience and north-fringe optionality matter more than quiet Loyang weekends alone. The pocket sits on the Tampines North / Pasir Ris / Loyang edges; housing mixes newer HDB, ECs, and selective condos. Expats land here for hub errands, school options, and ActiveSG gateball / petanque catchment without CBD premiums. Watch-outs: smoke-stop / staircase pressurisation fan test calendars on towers, school-run traffic, and confusing Tampines vs Tampines North Edge shortlists. Compare with Pasir Ris West Fringe for quieter park-connector calm, Loyang Edge for industrial-fringe quiet, and Tampines proper when mall gravity wins.
